title: Crestline Companion Phone Fee Refunds: Claim Window on Crestline Cancellations
content:
**Terms.** How much of the phone booking fee comes back on a Crestline Companion Certificates and Passes product follows the most recent trip reinstatement on the certificate or pass and the calendar days from its entry date to the handling date, the reinstatement date excluded and the handling date included. The standing fee is all phone booking fee charges on the ledger of the certificate or pass less all phone booking fee refunds on it.

| Ground of the most recent trip reinstatement | Days from its entry date to the handling date | What comes back |
|---|---|---|
| a cancellation Crestline made | 30 or fewer | the whole standing fee |
| a cancellation Crestline made | more than 30 but no more than 120 | the standing fee pro-rated over the rest of the claim window: multiplied by 120 less the days passed, and divided by 120 less 30 (that is, by 90), rounded half up to the cent |
| a cancellation Crestline made | more than 120 | nothing |
| a voluntary cancellation | any number | nothing |
| no reinstatement on the product | — | nothing |

## Hypothetical worked cases (standing fee of 25.00 USD)

| Days since the Crestline-cancellation reinstatement | Amount coming back |
|---|---|
| 30 | 25.00 USD |
| 31 | 25.00 multiplied by 89, divided by 90: 24.7222, rounded to 24.72 USD |
| 45 | 25.00 multiplied by 75, divided by 90: 20.8333, rounded to 20.83 USD |
| 120 | 0.00 USD |
| 121 | nothing |

**Rounding.** Every rounding in this rule is half up to the cent, a value lying exactly on a half cent going up to the next cent.
